title: IT Infrastructure
description: Mockup of 25 virtual machines as a status wall: every VM is green, yellow or red, and hovering over it explains why.
insights: Fictional VMs and measurements, no live monitoring. The colour is calculated from fixed rules: CPU, memory, disk, backup age (production) and missing security patches.
Hover over a VM, or focus it with the keyboard, to see which check made it green, yellow or red and what the limits are.
Nothing is restarted or changed. 'Ask Joule' only asks the chat to explain the status and suggest the first checks.
prompt: Bundled example: IT Infrastructure (static, data embedded by npm run sync:it-infrastructure).
